observations.support_span: By LC3 flux analysis in nutrient deprived conditions, where LC3II ratios in the presence and absence of lysosomal inhibitors (Leupeptin and NH 4 Cl) were calculated 20 , we identified slower LC3 flux in patient cells compared to controls.
